Plan the membership system for me. We should discuss the approach before changing code.
What is the best way to build this feature? Do not touch the code yet.

Interview me one consequential requirement at a time, challenge my assumptions, and record each decision before implementation.
The solution and specification are approved. Plan three months of milestones, owners, dependencies, handoffs, and replanning triggers.
The architecture decision is final. Write the formal technical specification using our prescribed document structure.
Change the Sign in button text to Log in and run the focused tests.
